build_CLIPTextEncoder_with_vocabulary: build a CLIPTextEncoder with a custom vocabulary list to encode class names into text embeddings
build_CLIPTextEncoder_with_dataset: build a CLIPTextEncoder using a dataset name to automatically load and encode class embeddings
test_encode_text_method: test the encode_text method by passing tokenized text inputs and verifying normalized embeddings are returned
test_template_encode_method: test the template_encode method by passing a vocabulary list and checking averaged template embeddings
review_CLIPTextEncoder_forward: review the CLIPTextEncoder forward method to understand caching logic and background embedding concatenation
